user_prompt: Our finance team currently uses our lease accounting system to track IFRS 16 liabilities and right-of-use assets, but we have no automated way to reconcile the lease modification adjustments that our real estate and equipment procurement teams make throughout the year against what's been recorded in our general ledger—we're manually reviewing dozens of modification notices each quarter and trying to match them to journal entries, which creates audit risk and delays our month-end close.

steps.step_name: We need an automated reconciliation capability to match lease modification adjustments made by our real estate and equipment procurement teams against the journal entries recorded in our general ledger for IFRS 16 liabilities and right-of-use assets.

The activity requires an automated reconciliation capability that matches lease modification adjustments against general ledger journal entries for IFRS 16 accounting. This is a specialized financial reconciliation and accounting function.

None of the candidates fulfill this requirement:
- The agents (AccessProvisioning, AssetProvisioning, ChangeAutomation, ChangeRelease, ProductLifecycle, BillOfMaterials) focus on IT asset management, engineering changes, product releases, and supply chain—not financial reconciliation or lease accounting
- The dataProducts (ProductChangeAndInventoryAnalytics, ProductImpactSalesIntelligence) provide sales and inventory insights, not financial reconciliation capabilities

While "Asset Provisioning Orchestrator" might superficially overlap with "assets" (right-of-use assets), it handles IT asset lifecycle management, not lease accounting reconciliation against general ledger entries. This is a topical false positive from the knowledge graph walk.

The activity requires financial/accounting domain expertise (IFRS 16 compliance, general ledger reconciliation) that none of these candidates—drawn from IT service management, CX, and manufacturing domains—actually provide.
